mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 30 days but the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (the 2017 base year level), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 but the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 quarterly growth rate is positive but the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines in the same month but the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's monetary tightening cycle is active, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% but the 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of such instances.
